answer: The summit counter is kept in quill and gale shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 37 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator as a result has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 37 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 127 aliases cost 381 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
